newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico cops caught calling sex hotline.
newsitem.headline: Mexico cops caught calling sex hotline.

text.p: Mexico City police officers have been caught using government telephones to call foreign sex lines and will have to pay for their not-so-cheap thrills, a police spokeswoman said on Thursday.

Officers at 20 police stations in one Mexico City district reportedly ran up about $8,900 in unpaid phone bills to explicit sex lines, forcing the telephone company to cut off police emergency telephone service to several neighbourhoods for 10 days.
"The internal control organisation has ordered the people responsible for those telephone calls to pay," police spokeswoman Alma Landeros told Reuters.

Angry neighbours denounced the suspension of the emergency telephone service saying they had witnessed several robberies and other crimes but could not get through to police, the daily Reforma reported.
Most of the sex calls were placed at night and showed up on the phone bill with names like "secrets," "confessions" and "fantasies."
Virtually all the calls, which began last March, were to foreign countries, including Canada, Chile and Moldova, Reforma said.
